capabilities: Render nested GFM tables as semantic HTML table elements
Repair indented callouts that appear as code blocks in Live Preview
Reveal original Markdown source when the cursor enters or clicks a rendered table
Keep folded callouts folded while preserving inline Markdown and links
disambiguation: Not a general nested-Markdown renderer; it only handles tables nested under list items and indented callouts, leaving top-level tables to Obsidian's native renderer.
extras: Desktop only in the initial release; mobile support is disabled pending testing. Requires Obsidian 1.12.7 or later. Installable via BRAT. The directory listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Render nested Markdown tables and indented callouts correctly in Obsidian Live Preview without changing note source.
motivation: The author built it to close the gap between Reading view, which renders nested GFM tables and indented callouts correctly, and Live Preview, which does not.
problem: Obsidian's Live Preview leaves tables nested under list items as pipe-delimited text and can degrade indented callouts into code blocks, even though Reading view renders them correctly.

relations.evidence: Indented Table improves the readability of pipe-delimited source with editor decorations.

summary: Live Preview renderer that displays nested GFM tables as real tables and repairs indented callouts without changing note source.
